meta_description: Ainsworth D J is a experienced plasterer in Birmingham. Professional interior and exterior plastering, rendering, and finishing work. Call for a free quote today.
hero_eyebrow: Experienced Plasterer — Quality Finishes Every Time
hero_subhead: From new builds to renovations, we deliver smooth, durable finishes that look and last.
services_subhead: Whether it's interior walls, external rendering, or specialist finishes, we handle every job with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Plastering
services.desc: Professional wall and ceiling plastering for new builds, extensions, and refurbishment work. Creates smooth, seamless finishes ready for decoration.

services.title: External Rendering
services.desc: Durable external render and harling to protect and refresh your property. Weather-resistant finishes that improve insulation and kerb appeal.

services.title: Textured Finishes
services.desc: Artex, Venetian, stippled, and decorative finishes. Adds depth and character to rooms whilst masking minor imperfections.

services.title: Crack Repair & Making Good
services.desc: Patch repairs, filling, and restoration work on damaged plasterwork. Blended seamlessly to match existing surfaces.

services.title: Skimming & Dry Lining
services.desc: Fast dry-lining installation and skim coating for quick interior upgrades. Ideal for damp-affected walls or dated rooms.

services.title: Commercial Plastering
services.desc: Large-scale contract work for offices, shops, and industrial units. Delivered on time and within budget with minimal disruption.

about_pullquote: A good finish isn't just about skill—it's about caring enough to get it right.
about_para_1: D J Ainsworth has been plastering homes and businesses across Birmingham for over 15 years. Built on word-of-mouth recommendations and a reputation for precise, reliable work, we've completed everything from small domestic repairs to major commercial projects.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we turn up on time, price fairly, and leave every site clean and tidy. Whether you need a single room skimmed or a whole building rendered, we approach every job with the same attention to detail.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had our lounge and hallway skimmed before redecorating. D J was professional, tidy, and finished the job bang on schedule. The walls look brilliant now—you'd never know they'd been patched. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Plastered our extension internally and rendered the outside. Excellent attention to detail. The render is spotless and the interior finish is perfect. Fair price too. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Helen W.

reviews.text: Called D J on a Friday for a quote on crack repairs and making good. He came out same day, explained what needed doing, and started work the following Monday. Everything sorted in two days. Real professional.
reviews.author: Andrew P.
